skipReasons.controlledServiceFailure: Public Cloudflare Lab has no test-only failure hook. The contract must not assume a specific server-function transport.
skipReasons.controlledWordlistFailure: Public Cloudflare Lab has no test-only failure hook, and the client word-list URL is a hashed framework chunk rather than a stable resource the contract can fail.
skipReasons.practiceSession: Practice stays disabled in production Lab, so a complete session cannot run against this target.
